name: dots-gateway
description: Remote development, Antigravity (agy) & OpenAI Codex (codex) MCP plugin enabling OpenAI dots to inspect/edit local files, execute allowlisted dev commands, and run agy or codex.

interface.shortDescription: Run local dev commands, edit workspace files, and invoke agy or codex via MCP
interface.longDescription: Bridges OpenAI dots to your remote development machine over a hardened TLS 1.3 + HMAC-SHA256 gateway via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Provides atomic workspace file operations (fs_read, fs_write, fs_patch, fs_list, fs_stat, fs_delete), allowlisted shell/build/test execution inside a Linux mount-namespace jail (exec_command), multi-turn background sessions (session_*), model discovery (list_agy_models), isolated read-only AGY & Codex plugin discovery with unified native hook sandboxing, optional policy-filtered Docker access, and unattended Antigravity (run_agy) & OpenAI Codex (run_codex) delegation.
defaultPrompt: Check remote gateway status and list projects in the default workspace.
Delegate feature implementation on my remote repo to run_agy and verify with run_codex review and pytest.
Inspect git status and run the test suite on my remote machine via dots-gateway.
